scale_gates.reason: Two device system reports recovered read-only on 2026-09-04 prove that exact TestFlight 1.1.0 (9) crashed on the iPad at 2026-09-03 13:45 and 14:49 +05:00. Both reports name the main `Nimbo` process rather than `NimboWidget`, match app/dSYM UUID 86A2A899-D90D-3820-B9FF-E4F35D0C19BF, and show EXC_BREAKPOINT/SIGTRAP on `com.apple.root.default-qos` through `_dispatch_assert_queue_fail` and `_swift_task_checkIsolatedSwift`. Exact-dSYM symbolication resolves the path to the inline completion in `AppDelegate.handleBackgroundRefresh(_:)`, the Swift-to-Kotlin thunk, and `startCancellableBackgroundRefresh` at BackgroundWeatherUpdater.kt:90. Read-only TestFlight detail separately reports 2 installs, 7 sessions, and 3 crashes for exact build 9; the group aggregate of 22 sessions and 8 crashes spans builds, and only two raw iPad reports were recovered and symbolicated. Build 9 created a MainActor-isolated Swift closure inside `@MainActor AppDelegate`, then Kotlin invoked it from Dispatchers.Default before its inner actor hop could run. Source authority fc4b6de9e28fd8956eb64462294b8bcdf405ce7e moves the outer completion and expiration callbacks into nonisolated `@Sendable` factories, explicitly hops to MainActor, and advances Apple to build 10. Protected signing run 33852229166, materialization run 33855931653, and final independent trusted run 33859392482 establish exact signed and byte-verified build-10 identity. Build 10 was delivered through Transporter, App Store Connect confirms the processed binary, and it is attached to the internal TestFlight group. Both connected iPhone and iPad run exact build 10; bounded smoke and a physical iPad Home Screen widget render are clean. A read-only 15:43 +05 poll found no new Nimbo crash file, but both app-group updated_at values still equalled their foreground baselines, so no exact-build OS-scheduled refresh completion has been observed. The corrected background path therefore remains unproved. Build 9 is runtime-failed; its App Store release was cancelled and its former submission ended as Developer Rejected. At 15:47 +05 it was detached from the editable version and exact build 10 was selected and saved instead. Version 1.1.0 is Prepare for Submission with manual release preserved; review resubmission remains blocked until the natural background gate passes. Build 9 must not be reattached or released, and no public release occurred. Public 1.0.1 also lacks a source-defined crash-free-session window. The gate remains blocked.
